# Amazon Careers

> Amazon's official careers portal connecting talent with opportunities across diverse teams, locations, and business divisions worldwide.

Amazon.jobs is the primary recruitment hub for Amazon, featuring job search capabilities, team browsing, location information, and comprehensive resources about company culture, benefits, and the hiring process. The site emphasizes Amazon's leadership principles, diversity initiatives, and employee experience across all business units including AWS, Alexa, Devices, Ads, and AGI divisions.

## Key Topics

- Leadership Principles
- Job Search & Categories
- Career Paths
- Hiring Process
- Teams & Divisions
- Global Locations
- Employee Benefits
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Company Culture
- Interview Preparation
- Workplace Culture
- Amazon Web Services
- Alexa
- Amazon Devices
- Organizational Structure

## Getting Started

- [Amazon Careers: Impact the Future, Today](https://amazon.jobs/en): Amazon careers homepage with job search, internships, and culture overview.
- [Job Categories](https://amazon.jobs/en/job_categories): Browse job categories and career paths at Amazon.
- [Teams](https://amazon.jobs/en/business_categories): Browse Amazon teams including Alexa, Devices, Ads, and AGI divisions.
- [Amazon Locations](https://amazon.jobs/en/locations): Explore Amazon office locations worldwide including Seattle headquarters.

## Company Culture & Values

- [Leadership Principles](https://amazon.jobs/content/our-workplace/leadership-principles): Amazon's leadership principles guiding company culture and hiring.
- [Our Workplace](https://amazon.jobs/content/our-workplace/working-at-amazon): Overview of Amazon workplace culture, benefits, and employee experience.
- [Inclusive Experiences](https://amazon.jobs/content/our-workplace/diversity-and-inclusion): Amazon diversity initiatives, employee resource groups, and inclusive culture.

## Hiring & Interview Process

- [How We Hire](https://amazon.jobs/content/how-we-hire/interviewing-at-amazon): Interview guide covering loop interviews, Bar Raisers, and preparation tips.
- [Accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/how-we-hire/accommodations): Request hiring accommodations and accessibility support by country.

## Benefits & Compensation

- [Global Employee Benefits](https://amazon.jobs/benefits/global): Global employee benefits including compensation, stock, and health insurance.

## Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://amazon.jobs/content/faq): FAQ covering job applications, hiring process, and interview preparation.

## Optional

- [Logout](https://amazon.jobs/logout): Logout page for Amazon careers portal.
